permission: Root requested an actual per-cell mechanical improvement. Only Models own command error and construction witness are summarized; other owner raw incidents and all machine paths remain private.
mode: Host owner read-command construction, no new model capability or software-Test case
problem: Own data-reading command accidentally supplied a JSON file as the explicit Python script. NameError at the JSON true literal was an owner command error, not a JSON syntax/model-service/source/Test failure. Original evidence remains unchanged.
mechanism: Define a trusted interpreter/readonly-reader argv prefix at the start of every read exec cell; data cannot choose that prefix.
Construct only from that fixed prefix, a separately validated absolute data path and finite integer range. Do not accept arbitrary raw shell text.
Before exec, require the final first token, every prefix token, total token count, data slot and range to equal the expected construction exactly; do not override cmd after this check.
Reject shell metacharacters and unsupported quoting/path forms before launching any process. This exact local no-space form rejects spaces and traversal rather than guessing shell escaping.
Authorized helper execution and Git use separate explicit constructions; file extensions never route a read into execution.

qualification_limits: Only this locally exercised constructor and its known readonly helper; not universal shell quoting, a sandbox or proof against a caller bypassing the construction.
Cross-machine instructions specify the invariant, not a fixed drive, interpreter or helper path; each machine validates its own prefix and supported quoting.
Historical unknown association/dispatch/UI effects remain unknown. No scan, kill, rollback, authority change or business replay is justified by this guard.
The original owner error is retained. A later correctly printed file does not retrospectively make the earlier command correct.
